description: The second member to reach the ungraded state, and the one the phase-5 review had to ask for (F1). RIT-006 proves the aggregator lifts the word from enforcement-pack; a member is only lifted if its name is in $ungradedCapableMembers, so proving it for one member proves nothing about the next. Here the stub is scope-check, and the assertion is that the word reaches the verdict line and the RESULT line rather than being flattened to OK - which is exactly what this member did before the remediation. Exit 0 in both directions (plan D6). Differs from the pass direction in exactly one line of one stub (plan D10).

write.scripts/scope-check.ps1:
param([string]$Root, [string]$Branch, [switch]$All, [switch]$Check)
Write-Host 'scope-check: UNGRADED no commit on ''main'' was graded — the reason is on the line(s) above'
exit 0
